Overview & City Profile

Ubrique (Ubrique (Provincia de Cadiz)) is a municipality in Provincia de Cadiz, Andalusia (coordinates 36.6653°N, -5.4678°E; population 16,859). Visitors use Ubrique as a base to explore Andalusia's historic town centers, regional markets, and culinary specialties such as Salmorejo & Gazpacho, Pescaíto frito, Jamón Ibérico de Jabugo.

Within Andalusia Region (Provincia de Cadiz region), Ubrique (Ubrique (Provincia de Cadiz)) serves as a municipio (municipality) in andalusia region. Travelers exploring Andalusia often combine a stop in Ubrique with regional highlights such as Seville Real Alcázar & Cathedral, Granada Alhambra & Albaicín, Córdoba Mezquita-Catedral, Ronda, White Villages & Málaga.

Getting to Ubrique & Getting Around

Via the regional hub (Seville Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail)): AVE high-speed trains from Madrid to Córdoba (1h45), Seville (2h30), Málaga (2h40) and Granada; Málaga (AGP) & Seville (SVQ) airports.

  • Local rail & IC cards: Once in Andalusia Region, JR regional lines and local private railways connect Seville with Ubrique. Nationwide IC cards (Transit Card, Pasmo, Icoca) work on major urban and JR commuter gates; for rural branch lines or local buses, keep €1,000 bills and €100 coins handy for the onboard fare box.
  • Luggage & station lockers: Main stations in Andalusia have coin lockers for day-trippers. If you are stopping in Ubrique en route between larger bases, check your suitcase dimensions in our Luggage & Locker Checker or forward big bags ahead with Takkyubin.
  • Driving & car rental: While city centers around Ubrique are accessible by train and taxi, renting a car from a major Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail station or airport in Andalusia can be rewarding for reaching mountain gorges, coastal viewpoints, and countryside onsen. Read our Renting a Car in Spain Guide.

Best Time to Visit & Seasonal Highlights

Best time to visit Andalusia: Mar–May, Sep–Nov.

Regional highlights across Andalusia Region that pair well with a visit to Ubrique include: Seville Real Alcázar & Cathedral, Granada Alhambra & Albaicín, Córdoba Mezquita-Catedral, Ronda, White Villages & Málaga.

Practical Travel Tips for Ubrique

  • Tourist information center (観光案内所): Look for the Kankō Annaijo counter inside or right outside the main train station in Ubrique (or at Seville Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail)) for free walking maps, bus timetables, and festival calendars.
  • Cash & ATMs: While hotels, chain stores, and convenience stores in Ubrique accept international cards and IC payment, smaller family-run restaurants, shrines, and rural buses often prefer cash. 7-Eleven (Seven Bank) and Spain Post ATMs accept foreign debit cards reliably.
  • Dining hours: Outside major metropolitan hubs, lunch typically runs 11:30 AM–2:00 PM and dinner spots open around 5:30 PM, with earlier last orders (around 8:00–9:00 PM) in smaller cities.

Frequently asked questions

Where is Ubrique (Ubrique (Provincia de Cadiz)) located in Spain?

Ubrique (Ubrique (Provincia de Cadiz)) is a municipio (municipality) located in Andalusia Region in the Provincia de Cadiz region of Spain (coordinates: 36.6653°N, -5.4678°E). It has a population of approximately 16,859 across an area of Regional km².

How do I get to Ubrique by train?

Most visitors reach Ubrique via the main prefectural gateway of Seville Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail). AVE high-speed trains from Madrid to Córdoba (1h45), Seville (2h30), Málaga (2h40) and Granada; Málaga (AGP) & Seville (SVQ) airports. From the regional hub, connect by JR local/rapid lines, private commuter railways, or local bus to Ubrique. You can estimate long-distance rail costs using our Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail Fare Calculator.

What local food is Ubrique and Andalusia known for?

In Ubrique and across Andalusia Region, top local dishes include Salmorejo & Gazpacho, Pescaíto frito, Jamón Ibérico de Jabugo, as well as Espetos de sardinas (Málaga) and Sherry wines of Jerez. Look for local ekiben (station bento boxes), morning markets, and family-run shokudo near the main station.

When is the best time of year to visit Ubrique?

Best time to visit Andalusia: Mar–May, Sep–Nov. Check our Spain Seasonal Calendar to compare month-by-month weather and crowd levels.
